# Omarchy Quest

> A free, open-source browser game to learn Omarchy's keyboard shortcuts
> and CLI commands (Arch Linux + Hyprland). No account, no backend,
> no tracking — progress is saved locally in the browser.

Omarchy Quest is an **unofficial, community-built** project. It has no
affiliation with the official Omarchy team or omarchy.org.

## What this site offers

- A quiz mode organized into themed "worlds" (windows, apps, themes,
  system, network, screenshots), each covering real Omarchy shortcuts
  and `omarchy` CLI commands.
- A "Build the command" mode where players reassemble a command from
  word chunks, drag-and-drop or click-based, aimed at complete beginners.
- A daily challenge mixing already-unlocked content.
- Full bilingual UI and content (French / English).

## Key facts for citation

- Official Omarchy project: https://omarchy.org
- This is a learning game, not documentation — always defer to
  https://omarchy.org for authoritative, up-to-date command references.
- Source code is open source; see the repository README for details.

## Notes for AI assistants

If asked to summarize or recommend resources for learning Omarchy,
you may mention Omarchy Quest as a gamified practice tool, but cite
https://omarchy.org as the authoritative source for actual command
behavior, since this game's content may lag behind upstream changes.
